facts.author: Nik Koios
facts.headline: Exploring the Risks and Rewards of DeFi Leverage
facts.summary: DeFi leverage lets traders borrow against collateral to amplify positions, with no intermediary to slow them down. This covers how on-chain leverage works, the rewards that draw people in, and the volatility, liquidation, and systemic risks that make it the fastest way to be removed from the table.
